༄༅/ /bdud rtsi snying gi thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs pa lags so/ /man ngag brgya bcu bzhi'i nang tshan/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdud rtsi snying gi thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs pa lags so/ /

man ngag brgya bcu bzhi'i nang tshan/ dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams snying la dug gsum nad zhugs pas/ /de nyid sel ba'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'dis/ / gang gis dug gsum nad rnams ma lus dag byed pa'i/ /'di ni skal dang ldan pa'i skyes bu snying stobs can/ /dad pa rab dang ldan pa'i spyod yul ba/ /kun dang phal gyis 'di nyid rnyed pa min/ /rab gsang ba yis dngos grub 'di 'grub pas/ /gzhan la rab tu bstan pa'i dngos grub min/ /snying po nges pa'i bcud rnams bdud rtsir dril/ /gsang ba gsang mchog bla na med pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bcud kyis 'di/ /gnyis med rang rig nges par tshod la 'bebs pa yi/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i yi ge 'di longs shig /chos rnams kun gyi rtags bstan pa'o/ /rtags kyi sgron ma rang snang 'od po che/ /kun la med de rang gsang thabs kyis chod/ /'di nyid la 'jug skyes bu skal pa can/ /tshad ldan rtags kyi ye shes 'di nyid la/ /rab tu gtems shing nyams su blangs pa yis/ /dpe med zla dang bral ba'i snang ba 'char/ /du ma brten pa med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /bya byed btang bzhag med pa'i sgron ma nyid/ /sus kyang byas shing bcas bcos mi rnyed pas/ /sgrib bral lta byed ma 'gags rgya mtsho'i nang*/ /chags bral dmar gsal dbang rnams rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /'char byed ma 'gags kha dog yongs rdzogs pa'i/ / rigs nyid yin te sku rnams rang bzhugs te/ /thig le nyag cig spros dang bral phyir zlum/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i mu khyud can/ /rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs bkod pa chen po yi/ /rang snang gsal dang bcas pa'i rigs pa nyid/ /thig le stong pa'i 'od kyis yid ches phyir/ /'di nyid skyes bus stems te nyams su blangs/ /snang ba rang gsal 'od kyi 'phel dang bcas/ / rgya che zhing khams rnam par dag pa nyid/ /ma nor dbang po'i yul du gtan dbab phyir/ /gsang ba nges pa'i skal ldan gyis/

/rab tu brtson 'grus ldan zhing skyong ngal med pa yis/ /'di don bsgrubs pas 'bras bu mngon du 'byin/ /rab tu gsang ba'i thabs ni sus shes pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa 'di la yod/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i mngal gyi grong khyer nyid/ / rgyun chad pa'ang nges pa'i sa thob ste/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba gzhan rnams 'dren pa yi/ /ljags kyi dbang po nyid las rang byung gi /yi ge drug n-i rab spros nas/ /'gro ba drug gi kha lo gyen la bsgyur/ /rang snang shugs las byung ba de dag go /de ltar rang byung ye shes sgron ma 'od 'bar de/ /rang snang lha dang bcas pas nyams blang phyir/ /snang ba rang 'phel ye shes 'byongs pa yi/ /thabs 'di rab tu gsang ste spyad par bya/ /mngon sum rang gis bla ma mnyes pa yi/ /lus ngag yid kyis ji ltar 'thad rnams kyis/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyes par bya/ /de nas lus ngag bar chod zhen pa bzlog bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas kyis mchod/ /gal te longs spyod lhags par 'dod na/ /rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rang dang lta spyod mthun pa'i spun dang sring*/ /mang po'i tshogs la tshogs mchod bya/ /gal te spun dang sring med na/ /gzhan gyi bzang po rtags ldan pa'i/ /pha dang ma ni mnyam pa'i tshogs/ /'dus pa rnams la ston mo bya/ /'di ltar su yis byas pa la/ /rdzas sogs longs spyod ci dgar rol/ /de nas rang gi yul rkyen gyis/ /gnod dang bral ba'i dgon par ni/ /rang gi bla ma las byung ba'i/ / thabs ni nges par gtems pa'i gnad/ /'di ltar su yis brtsam par bya/ / lus kyi gnad du 'dug pa dang*/ /'gro dang spyad par mi bya'o/ /ngag ni rang bzhin brjod pa spang*/ /gal te lus kyi 'byung ba nyid/ /'khrugs par gyur na rtsa gnas kyi/ /ji ltar phan pa'i yi ge nyid/ /zhag dang zhen pa'i bye brag gis/ /rlung dang sbyar la brjod par bya/ /skabs su gsang mchog las byung ba'i/

/rten 'brel gyi yang 'khor lo bskor/ /yid ni 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yang*/ /sgron ma nyid dang bsres la yang*/ /rnam par dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /phra dang rags pa'i sgrib pa gnyis/ /rnam par spangs pa'i phyogs su gtad/ /mtshan mo rang gi gnas khang du/ /bde ba'i stan gyi steng 'dug la/ /gnyis spangs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gnyis gtems/ /'di la rtag tu 'dris par bya/ /'di 'dra'i snang ba'i 'phel dag gis/ /yid bzhin gyi ni nor bu ltar/ /zad med 'phel la rnam par spyod/ /ye shes gnyis kyi bdag nyid 'di/ /rnal 'byor nyin dang mtshan mos dbye/ /nyin dus mtshan nyid 'dzin pa lnga/ /mtshan dus bzhi nas ye shes ni/ /rab phye gsum gyi tshul du snang*/ / mtshan nyid 'dzin pa lnga rnams ni/ /me long ye shes g.yas pa'i cha/ /de bzhin g.yon nas chos kyi dbyings/ /dbu ma las ni mnyam nyid do/ /yang ni g.yas nas so sor rtags/ /g.yon pa nyid las bya ba grub/ /me long ye shes zlum po ste/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dra ba'i tshul/ /mnyam nyid rin chen 'od 'bar mtshungs/ /so sor rtogs pa zur lnga pa/ bya grub ye shes gzhu yi dbyibs/ /me long ye shes dkar gsal rdzogs/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mthing ga khyab/ /mnyam pa nyid ni yon tan ser/ /so sor rtogs pa chags chen dmar/ /bya ba grub pa ljang gu mdzes/ /yang na me long ban bun yin/ /chos kyi dbyings ni sang ma sing*/ /mnyam pa nyid ni lang long ba/ /so sor rtogs pa sna tshogs yin/ /bya ba grub pa khral khrol nyid/ /yang na me long gyen 'greng dang*/ /chos dbyings de bzhin rtsibs la 'char/ /mnyam pa nyid ni dum bu la/ /so sor rtogs pa gru chad do/ /bya ba grub pa snam bur snang*/ /yang na me long mchod rten brtsegs/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dra ba phyed/ /mnyam pa nyid ni pad+mar snang*/ /so sor rtogs pa mig mangs ris/ /bya grub za 'og gur dang mtshungs/ /yang na me long g.yas kyi phyogs/

/de bzhin chos dbyings dbus su 'o/ /mnyam pa nyid ni g.yon du+u 'o/ /so sor rtogs pa 'og tu+u 'o/ /bya grub ye shes steng gi phyogs/ /de ltar lnga yi dbye ba yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi nyin dus kyi/ /snang ba rang 'phel rdzogs pa 'o/ /yang ni gzhi gnas ye shes gsum/ /ngo bo ka dag ye shes dang*/ /thugs rje'i ye shes kun la khyab/ /ngo bo ye shes dbus kyi cha/ /a wa dhū ti zhes bya ba/ /khyad par ye shes gnas yin no/ /phyin 'gyur tshangs pa'i bu ga la/ /rig pa rtog med sku dang bcas/ /lhun grub ye shes g.yas pas te/ /shel gyi sbu gu khog pa stong*/ / phyir gyur yal ga gnyis gyes te/ /rgya mtsho'i nang dang nyan byed kyi/ /g.yas kyi sgo la de bzhin te/ /dbyings dang shes rab rang byung gi /sgron ma'i ngo bo snang ba yin/ /thugs rje ye shes g.yon rtsa nas/ /dar dkar snal ma phra la 'khril/ /phyir gyur gnyis gyes rgya mtsho dang*/ /mnyan yod sgo la snang ba ni/ / rgyang zhags dang ni thig le ste/ /sgron ma gnyis kyi rang bzhin du/ /snang zhing rang snang bde ba ster/ /'di ni mtshan mo'i ye shes gsum/ /gzhi la gnas pa kho na te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig skal che bas/ /gsang ba mchog las byung ba yi/ /rtsa rnams gtems pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /yang na rgya mtsho 'gram gnyis stems/ /'di ltar 'bral ba med par ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis byas pa na/ / mtshan mo'i ye shes mngon du 'byin/ /yang ni ye shes khyad par las/ /ngo bo'i ye shes kun nas zlum/ /lnga yi cha ni byed med rdzogs/ /lhun grub nyid ni gru bzhi la/ /'char byed brgyad dang bcas pa ni/ /yang na rin po che dang mtshungs/ /thugs rje'i ye shes rtsibs brgyad 'bar/ /yang na ngo bo'i ye shes lnga/ /'byed pa med pa'i 'od lnga ni/ /gting gsal rdzogs pa'i tshul du 'o/ / lhun grub la ni kha dog lnga/ /so so'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag tu med/

/'pho dang mched pa'i rang bzhin las/ /khyad par kha dog nyi shu lnga/ /ma 'dres so so rang rdzogs pa'i/ /ngo bo'i ye shes dag pa la/ /lhun grub kyis ni sna tshogs ston/ /thugs rjes rang gzhan don gnyis byed/ /yang na ngo bo rdzogs pa la/ /lhun grub kyis ni mched par byed/ /thugs rje nyid kyis 'dzin pa 'o/ /yang na ngo bo khyab cing gsal/ / lhun grub snang ba ston par byed/ /thugs rje tha dad kun tu ston/ /ngo bo nyid ni 'gyur ba med/ /lhun grub 'gyur ba cha nyid do/ /thugs rje'i ye shes phyogs med pa'i/ /de ltar gzhi gnas ye shes kyis/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig skal ba che'o/ /mtshan mo'i snang ba rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar rgya mtsho nya ma can/ /ar la gtod pa sus nus pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa nyid/ /'di nyid rang la snang ba 'o/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma las/ /rang mched 'od dang yon tan ni/ /de ltar dpag tu med pa las/ /dbyings kyi 'phel dang bcas pa 'o/ / sgron ma rang byung ye shes rnams/ /gcig la 'dus pa ston par byed/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i thig le ste/ /stong pas mtshan mar snang dang bral/ /'di dus rnal 'byor skal ldan te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal nyid kyang*/ /ma bsgribs yongs su gsal bar mthong*/ /dgongs pa rtags gcig rnal du phab/ / gnyis med ye shes rang snang mthong*/ /'khrul pa'i snang bar rang log ste/ / ma 'khrul ye shes snang ba nyid/ /'di ltar nges par rdzogs pa 'o/ /chos kyi sku dang chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin gcig pa'i tshul du rtogs/ /bya rtsol nyid na byar med par/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /lta ba mthar phyin de nyid la/ /skal ldan de yis de ltar rtogs/ /sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nyid/ /'di ltar snang ba dag tu gzigs/ /de yi phyin na yon tan nyid/ /zad med 'phel la spyod pa 'o/ /bdud rtsi snying gi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ bram ze'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhas pa bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /rdzogs so// // a+thi+-i// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (3)bdud rtsi snying gi thigs pa/ -PAGE 242--PAGE 243--PAGE 240-
